A 5-step budget comparison workflow where a user compares typical budgets
across Horizon Europe action types (RIA, IA, EIC), explores per-partner
budgets, organization type variations, coordinator vs partner differences,
and budget trends over 2021-2024. Tests the system's ability to provide
accurate budget statistics and comparisons with clear explanations.
